name: Perfect Form (body)
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 4, bard 4, cleric/oracle 4, druid 4, magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner 4

EFFECT

Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)
Target Restrictions Personal, Selected

DESCRIPTION

The target of a wordspell with this effect word receives a +4 enhancement to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution.
